name: Ships
overview: Scripture reveals the significance of ships as vessels of both physical and symbolic journeying, exemplified by the ark in Genesis which was lifted above the waters during the flood, demonstrating God's providential preservation. The tribes of Israel, such as Zebulun, are associated with harbors and ships, highlighting their role in commerce and travel. Ships are also portrayed as instruments of power and conflict, as seen in Numbers where ships from Chittim bring affliction. Additionally, Solomon’s establishment of a navy at Eziongeber underscores the strategic and economic importance of ships in biblical times.
